name: Research Communication & Bioethics
description: The course gives the student a forum to learn communicate research, to critique the research of colleagues and learn about the best research in their fields. Special topics in research will be assigned by the coordinator; tutorial activities including seminars on their research, critical analyses of other research seminars, discussion on ethical concerns in bio-research; good scientific practices; research writing; understanding and avoiding plagiarism; ethical use of software tools, artificial intelligence and statistical tools in biosciences.
